body: Measured cost of the current behaviour, from 15 headless stream-json logs on 1.4.0–1.4.2 with Gemini 4 Argon High (1,279 model calls): 17 calls were full-context resends with `cache_read_tokens` 0 (114k–268k input each, 3.29M tokens in total), which was 31 % of all uncached input tokens in those runs, from 1.3 % of the calls. Three were the first call after `agy -c`; fourteen happened mid-run without any visible trigger. Separately, 22 compactions each rebuilt the cache from zero with a 45–70k uncached call. So the quota drain here is not only the size of the context, it is how often the cached prefix is lost. Details and the design asks (a byte-stable prefix contract, a `cache_miss` event in the stream, compaction run against the cached prefix) are in #1291; the context-cap side is in #1245.
